requirements.text: Students should be able to customize their timetable views with features like color-coding modules, hiding cancelled classes, and adding personal study blocks.
Automated notifications should alert students when new grades are posted, as well as provide reminders for assignment deadlines and exam dates, ensuring notifications are quick and manageable.
A structured module feedback system should allow students to submit anonymous feedback on module content quality and delivery after the teaching period ends.
The enhancements must maintain the stability of the existing portal infrastructure to avoid disruptions.
Integration of the new features should align with existing user access and data handling protocols.
